setting.accent: Accent color for Prism themes. Default follows each palette.
setting.customAccent: Custom accent in #RRGGBB format. Used when Accent is Custom.
setting.contrast: Standard Prism borders or stronger borders and secondary text. Does not replace a VS Code High Contrast theme.
setting.italicComments: Use italic comments in Prism themes.
setting.boldKeywords: Use bold keywords in Prism themes.
setting.codeFont: Font preference. Run Apply Editor Typography to apply globally. Default restores your previous font. Fonts are not downloaded.
setting.ligatures: Ligature preference. Applied only by Apply Editor Typography; Inherit restores your previous value.
setting.smoothCaret: Smooth cursor preference. Applied only by Apply Editor Typography.
setting.smoothScrolling: Smooth editor scrolling preference. Applied only by Apply Editor Typography.
setting.cornerStyle: Corner style inside Theme Studio only. VS Code workbench corners remain native.
setting.ambientIntensity: Ambient glow intensity inside Theme Studio only.
setting.motion: Motion inside Theme Studio only. System reduced-motion preferences take priority.
setting.language: Theme Studio language. Auto follows VS Code; does not change the editor display language.
setting.preferredDark: Dark palette for Apply System Appearance. Saving this preference alone does not enable auto switching.
setting.preferredLight: Light palette for Apply System Appearance. Saving this preference alone does not enable auto switching.
